title: Skew fields of non-commutative meromorphic functions affiliated to finite operator algebras
summary: We embed skew fields of meromorphic functions in several non-commuting variables into the topological $*-$algebra of closed linear operators affiliated to a finite von Neumann algebra, $\mathfrak{M}$, with faithful, normal tracial state, $τ$.
